fastPathWindow.boundary: Reader checks 0x38 available bytes, copies 16+16+16+8 bytes from its current byte pointer to the output struct, then advances pointer and two consumed counters by 0x38. Cold/refill paths are not described by this window.

evidenceBoundary.exact: Selected formatter fast path reads one raw 56-byte BezierKnot value; selected native struct offsets map those bytes to three float3 vectors, one quaternion and one float. Current LevelData spline list framing uses that same stride.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: The window does not prove a live caller, cold/refill implementation, spline semantics or a changed future build. The LevelData corpus gate separately checks selected exported payloads through EOF.
